North Coquitlam homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

North Coquitlam, September 2026. No detached houses were listed or sold in North Coquitlam between June and September. Condos and townhomes: 149 listed at month end and 11 sold in September, a sales ratio of 7% (a buyers’ market).

items.t: North Coquitlam condos and townhomes for sale

blocks.text: North Coquitlam home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

195 condos sold in North Coquitlam with a median price of $600,000 (the middle half sold between $510,000 and $669,000), taking a median of 23 days to sell at 97.3% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $684 per square foot, a median year built of 2009 and a median strata fee of $460 a month. 3 townhomes sold in North Coquitlam, too few (5 needed) to give a typical price.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in North Coquitlam?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 149 condos and townhomes listed in North Coquitlam. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is North Coquitlam a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes had 7% (a buyers’ market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in North Coquitlam from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 0 houses and 86 condos and townhomes sold in North Coquitlam over those 4 months; condos and townhomes peaked in June with 34 sold.

faq.q: How big is North Coquitlam compared with the rest of Coquitlam?
faq.a: In September 2026, North Coquitlam held 18.5% of the 806 condos and townhomes listed in Coquitlam.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in North Coquitlam than in June?
faq.a: Listings of condos and townhomes was little changed, 147 in June and 149 in September 2026 (+1.4%).

faq.q: What did condos in North Coquitlam sell for?
faq.a: 195 condos sold in North Coquitlam between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $600,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in North Coquitlam?
faq.a: The median was 23 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.3% of the last list price (4% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
